production.note: US model years. The F-Type R is split by year range because the car changed twice: rear-wheel drive and 550 hp for 2015, all-wheel drive and 550 hp for 2016 to 2020, all-wheel drive and 575 hp for 2021 to 2024. This record is the 575 hp car. First: Jaguar's US brochure for the restyled range, dated December 2019 with a 2020 copyright, is the first to list the R with 575 hp; US outlets and the hosting site file it as the 2021 model year. Last: Jaguar says of 2024, "This marks the final model year of F‑TYPE" (jaguar-us-f-type-final-year-2023); for 2024 the 575 hp car was sold as the "F-TYPE P575 R75 AWD" (jaguar-us-2024-model-year-highlights), counted here as the R's last year. The 2022 and 2023 model years were not checked individually.

body.note: The brochure gives the 575 hp car a curb weight for both Coupe and Convertible. The Convertible keeps the variant name, so it is not a separate record. Jaguar's final-year release: 'In Coupé or Convertible form'.

configuration.note: Cylinders/valves per cylinder '8/4', 'Vee' layout. Jaguar's 2024 list: '5.0L Supercharged V8 (575 hp / 516 lb-ft)' (jaguar-us-2024-model-year-highlights).

fuel.note: Inferred: a supercharged V8 with no hybrid or electric system mentioned.

drivetrain.note: Driveline row, 575 hp column: 'All Wheel Drive (AWD)'. Jaguar's final-year release: 'Offered exclusively with all‑wheel drive' (jaguar-us-f-type-final-year-2023).

transmission.note: 'eight‑speed Quickshift transmission with full manual control' (a torque-converter automatic). The brochure lists the transmission only as 'Automatic'. No manual was offered on the V8.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Maximum power (hp/rpm)" 575/6,500 in the P575 column, which the brochure identifies as the F-TYPE R ("a 575HP engine supported by an enhanced chassis"). Jaguar's 2024 list repeats it: "F-TYPE P575 R75 AWD ... 5.0L Supercharged V8 (575 hp / 516 lb-ft)". The 2015 to 2020 R was rated 550 hp and is not part of this record.

weightLb.note: R Coupe, all-wheel drive, 8-speed automatic (the only transmission). Quote: "Curb weight (lbs)" 3,843 in the P575 Coupe column; the Convertible is 3,887. Footnotes: "Weights reflect vehicles to standard specifications. Optional extras increase weight." and "Includes full fluids and 90% fuel."
